item.title: WTT Feeder Series 2026: Manush Shah, Ryu Hanna Win Men’s And Women’s Singles Titles (Ld)
item.description: SAMA Indoor Sports Complex: Top seed and local favourite Manush Shah and Korea’s Ryu Hanna achieved contrasting victories to win the men’s and women’s singles titles, respectively, at the WTT Feeder Series 2026, presented by the Sports Authority of Gujarat, held at the SAMA Indoor Sports Complex on Sunday.

item.title: Royal Challengers Bengaluru Women vs UP Warriorz Women, Match 5, WPL 2026, Who will win today RCB-W vs UPW-W match?
item.description: The next game of the WPL 2026 will be played between Royal Challengers Bengaluru Women and UP Warriorz Women on Monday in Navi Mumbai.

item.title: Men's HIL: Ranchi Royals Register First Win With Stunning 4–1 Comeback Against Shrachi Bengal Tigers
item.description: Ranchi Royals secured their first win of the Men’s Hockey India League (HIL) 2025-26 season in spectacular fashion, defeating defending champions Shrachi Bengal Tigers 4-1. Playing in front of a passionate home crowd, the Royals staged a massive late-game comeback, scoring four times in the final six minutes to snatch all three points.

item.title: Sri Lanka Edge Pakistan by 14 Runs in Rain-Hit Third T20 to Level Series 1-1
item.description: Sri Lanka secured a hard-fought 14-run win over Pakistan in the rain-hit third T20 at Dambulla, leveling the series 1-1 with Wanindu Hasaranga starring with four wickets.

item.title: Bayern Rout Wolfsburg To Tighten Grip On Bundesliga Summit
item.description: Substitute Raphael Guerreiro: Bayern Munich turned a tight contest into a rout with a powerful second half to hammer Wolfsburg 8-1 at the Allianz Arena and tighten their grip on the Bundesliga summit.

item.title: ECB Mulls Bringing Back Player Curfew After Ashes Fiasco: Report
item.description: T20 World Cup: England may bring back a player curfew ahead of their upcoming white-ball tour of Sri Lanka and India after concerns grew over the team’s off-field behaviour during the recently concluded Ashes series in Australia.

item.title: Raphinha Shines As Barca Beat Madrid To Retain Spanish Super Cup Trophy
item.description: Spanish Super Cup: Raphinha was FC Barcelona's hero as his side retained the Spanish Super Cup with a 3-2 win over Real Madrid.

item.title: 'He Walks The Talk...,' Shreyas Lauds Kohli's Years Of Consistency
item.description: New Delhi: India batter Shreyas Iyer reserved special praise for Virat Kohli after the latter achieved two major milestones with his brilliant 93-run knock in the first ODI against New Zealand on Sunday.

item.title: Kyrgios Running Out Of Time For Grand Slam Run, Says Ex-Aus Open Director
item.description: Former Australian Open: Former Australian Open director Paul McNamee has said the absence of Nick Kyrgios from the singles draw is unlikely to affect the tournament, adding that time is running out for the Aussie to have a run at a grand slam.

item.title: WPL: 'We Stayed In The Contest Till The Very End,' Says Nandini Sharma After DC’s Narrow Loss To GG
item.description: Nandini Sharma: After the Delhi Capitals narrowly missed victory by four runs against the Gujarat Giants, pacer Nandini Sharma hailed the team's spirited all-round performance, saying the way the team fought till the end was commendable.
